sections.text: Protection
Technical Procedure
Introduction

This procedure details the steps required to completely check the proper 
 operation and calibration of the relay. It is recommended this procedure be 
 carried out on an annually bases. The document is formatted the way to 
 minimize the possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to 
 equipment.

P126 is designed around a common hardware and software platform in order to 
 achieve a high degree of conformity between products. One such product in the 
 range is the directional over current and directional earth fault relay. Using a wide variety of protection and automatic control function, the MICOM 
 directional over current relays can provide protection for many applications 
 including over head line and under ground cables at transmission and 
 distribution voltage levels.

The first is initiated by eng. Eyhab Zakaria, tested by eng. Sidhom Nassef & El-Sayed 
Edres, 
revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, accepted by eng. Aly Zahran: 
general manager & eng. Samir Abdel-Gilil: MDEPC quality control general director, approved by eng. Ahmad Sawan: head sector of Nubaria 
PS, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: MDEPC quality 
control head sector.
Safety Precautions

items: A work permit must be issued

The qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area
Line isolation is required.

Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current 
 circuits for test distance protection.
Transmission Line must be grounded.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: ISA DRTS tester.
Test leads.
PC laptop with necessary software {ISAWIZARD and ENER VISTA}
Tools bag.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Preparation

Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolate the relay current circuits for test.

Be sure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying DC voltmeter 
 across points (33,34) on the rear of the relay.

sections.text: Back up for OHTL 500kv
Over Current 51P

RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION AND DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> 
X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>
Insert the test plug in the terminal block .
Connect 3 phase currents to test plug X51 to terminals 22,24,26 and 28.
Disable other functions.
GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A].

Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the 
relay

Select fault and short current value equal to (1.2*I Setting) to determine 
the operating time.

sections.text: Directional Earth Fault

RUN ISA WIZARD software and choose GENERATION 
and DISTRIBUTION 
RELAYS>>>>X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>
Connect 1 phase voltage to test plug X51 to terminals 2,4.
Disable other functions.

GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION 
[I=0.1A, V=57 v, between I and V=. degree].

Choose Delta ramp with step 
∆= -10ْ to get positive pickup angle of 
the relay with starting by 120ْ.

Repeat step 5 with step ∆= 10ْ 
to get negative pickup angle of the relay with starting by 250ْ.

Choose Delta ramp with step 
∆I= 0.01 Amp, =0ْ , and V=50 v to get pickup current of the relay. [note prefault 
current = 0.05A]

Select fault and short current value equal to (1.05*I Setting) and =0ْ 
, and V=50 v to determine the operating time.
STORE ALL TESTS

Now you have complete test 
results for this relay.

sections.text:
Return Relay and Associated 
Equipment to Service
Enable any function which was disabled.

Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay 
terminals and the test set.
Make sure CT and VT secondary circuits are in normal condition.

Remove the disturbance alarm LED's on the relay which is caused by the 
test.
Request feeder to be returned in service.

Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to 
those for normal load condition.

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW, MVAR, Amperes and 
power factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
